audit.why: Phase chart and content win[] agree Brand takes Levels 1-3 and Pyke flips from 4-5 onward, matching the packet levelChart.
Spikes (Brand bullies lvl2, DFB lvl6 as equalizer, Dirk 1st item, late scaling) are concrete and grounded in his kit's poke/immobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Sear as the read but has no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never states that a landed Sear cancels Pyke's Q channel or that Pillar of Flame's landing zone threatens Pyke's E/R dash paths.
audit.why: Sear (Q) is 8-6s and hard CC — it cancels Bone Skewer's channel on hit. Pillar of Flame has a cast delay that telegraphs its crater, which can clip an E dash or R blink if thrown through it.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. It writes your spacing rules. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Sear (Q) is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and only stuns you ablaze — after eating W or E, that's the dodge line; landed, it also cancels your Q channel. - Pillar of Flame (W)'s delay telegraphs its crater — dash around it, not through, or it clips your E/R. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not trades.

edits.before: Q-threat the cover, E the gap, X the threshold — the chain pays your whole team.
edits.after: Sear only stuns you ablaze — clean HP means his combo starter whiffs and the hook window is yours.

edits.before: Fishing visibly at half HP — Pyke's health bar is a rumor only fog can keep.
edits.after: Diving in with a fresh Blaze stack up lets one more Sear finish the stun-lock — clear the stacks first.
